title: MES Opcenter Execution Core Architect Position
description:
**MES Opcenter Execution Core Architect 8\+ Yrs**
**Enterprise Performance**
 The Enterprise Performance Portfolio is a collection of Offerings that helps clients achieve the maximum possible impact and value from their investments in Finance, Supply Chain and IT operations. By taking a holistic view of these key business functions from strategy articulation through process design and technology enablement, we can help our clients navigate their challenges while operating components of their business. As our clients drive towards their digital future, Finance, Supply Chain, and IT play an increasingly important role in how these organizations interact with their customers, suppliers, and other key stakeholders. By combining our strategy, operations improvement, implementation, and operate capabilities, we can be more creative in how we deploy our resources and drive innovation at market pace.
   

  

**The Team \- Supply Chain \& Network Operations**
 The Enterprise Performance team brings rich industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our professionals are aligned to the Supply chain Network operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance. The SCNO service line helps companies build lasting competitive advantage at every level of their operations across product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics and distribution. We specialize in connecting high\-level strategies to measurable results on the front lines.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
**Responsibilities**
 As a Professional in our team you’ll work side by side with innovative and strategic thought leaders and stay ahead of the rapidly evolving world of business. You’ll get the training to be confident and prepared to help tackle some of our clients’ most complex business issues. You’ll work with diverse global clients across a wide range of industries. You should have exceptional communication and analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings to clients and team members and the ability to manage and lead teams independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment. Direct experience in MES Project Management, or MES Requirements Analysis or as a MES Solution Architect in discrete and process manufacturing is desirable. You will work with teams and responsibilities may include:
   

  

* Provide functional and technical support for Siemens manufacturing execution systems (Opcenter, APS, AIP, Connect MOM, etc.) deployed in various manufacturing domains.
* Architect enterprise, customer and operating model strategies and develop proposals and eminence around Siemens Opcenter solutions.
* Act as technical and solution architect for fast\-paced supply chain projects leveraging the Siemens MOM suite.
* Lead individual project teams in identifying business requirements, functional design, prototyping, process design (including scenario design, flow mapping), testing, training, defining support procedures and supporting Siemens implementations.
* Conduct workshops for requirements validation, data model design and configuration validation, and lead customer design sessions to formulate and document Opcenter solutions.
* Interaction with Subject Matter Experts / plant users / various stake holders for AS\-IS study of current landscape and define, design TO\-BE plan for Opcenter MES.
* Provide Industry standard best practices and align Enterprise Architecture to the Siemens MES Roadmap defined for the clients.
* Work with Deloitte Team members/ Project Managers/Senior Managers on end\-to\-end high\-level design discussions and long\-term approach for sustaining the Opcenter solution.
* Design and development of Integration with systems like Plant control systems, ERP, PLM, APS, and LIMS.
* Be the SME for the development and deployment phases of the project, providing technical work\-around options to fill the gaps in the application/functional requirements specific to Siemens tools.
* Help implement and maintain processes for Master data setup for products and processes within Opcenter.
* Work with teams to deliver system solutions for customers and participate in the entire sales cycle from proposals, support through deployment of the customers solution.
* Contribute to the growth and development of Deloitte’s Siemens Manufacturing Execution System (MES) offering and provide market driven product requirements to internal teams.
* Assist project teams and business teams to verify the configurations/customizations during development, testing, and deployment phases to verify an end\-to\-end solution for our clients.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience on Siemens products \- Opcenter Execution Core or Camstar and MOM Connect.
* Strong hands\-on experience in configuration and customization of Opcenter Execution Core functionalities – Experience on modelling, Designer \& Portal studio
* Experience of Mendix and Opcenter\-Mendix integration
* Hands\-on experience of developing interfaces using CN MOM / MOM Connect
* In\-depth knowledge of ISA\-95/S88 standards and their application in Opcenter MES design.
* Knowledge of GxP, GAMP, and 21 CFR Part 11 standards.
* Strong functional understanding of Level 3 and Level 4 systems, and familiarity with SAP\-MES integration and Level 2 automation systems.
* Solid knowledge on BOM, Manufacturing Work Plans, MBOM and BOP is needed.
* Strong experience with Java and C\# .NET, Oracle / SQL Database, and good working knowledge of Database like SQL Server \& SQL Store Procedures.
* MES to ERP integration; Restful API and Webservices development experience.
* Familiar with Quality Management, Dispatch Management, Scheduling, WIP Tracking, Resource Tracking, Maintenance Management, etc.
* In touch with industry 4\.0 trends, with emerging digital supply networks and exponential technologies, with industry automation tools and where the market and technology are pointing.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation and documentation skills (Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, etc.).
* Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment.
* Able to work independently and efficiently to meet deadlines, and multi\-task multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to work in shifts to support different regions.


**Preferred**
* Experience in Siemens MES Global Manufacturing Suites, specifically Opcenter, APS, AIP, and Connect MOM.
* Exposure to Siemens products like DIS, Insights Hub, Opcenter Intelligence, APS is an advantage.
* Exposure to customization using Mendix is an advantage.
* Knowledge of MES Design, Development, Testing and Implementation processes.
* Experience in interface development.


**Qualifications Required**
* Undergraduate degree/Professional Degree, with First Class/Distinction in B Tech or B E
* MCA/M Tech/MSc


**How You’ll Grow**
 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state\-of\-the\-art, world\-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Deloitte’s culture**
 Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
   

  

**Corporate citizenship**
 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

 Join a team building modern, real\-time decisioning platforms for fraud analysis and prevention. As a Principal Software Engineer / Solution Architect, you will define and lead the architecture for a customer\-facing platform within the Decision Management Platform (DMP), focused on Decision Products UI (DPUI), also known internally as The Fraud Center. This role owns the API, service, data, and integration architecture for DPUI and works in close partnership with the UI Architect, who leads the user interface architecture.
   

  

 You will shape technical direction, architecture strategy, and governance to ensure the platform is secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise and regulatory expectations. Working closely with product teams, UI Architect, and engineering, UX, and operations partners, you will guide DPUI through modernization, customer enhancements, and business cases that require new capabilities or changes to existing services.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Lead the architecture for the DPUI API, service, and data layers, ensuring they support analyst workflows, customer\-facing capabilities, real\-time service interactions, and integration with the wider DMP platform.
* Define target\-state solutions and guide the design of applications and services across event review, case management, report management, rules and strategy management, and operational workflows.
* Shape architecture across APIs, microservices, database technologies, and integration patterns to support scalable, resilient, high\-performance transaction processing.
* Produce clear architecture deliverables to support decision\-making, governance, and delivery alignment.
* Drive architecture decisions to closure, balancing long\-term direction with practical delivery needs, platform stability, customer enhancements, and business case priorities.
* Partner closely with product teams and the UI Architect to shape solution roadmaps, define viable transition states, and align technical decisions with business priorities and delivery sequencing.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams through design reviews, implementation guidance, and delivery support.
* Work across engineering, UX, operations, and SMEs to ensure solutions are cohesive, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to governance, assurance, and architecture review processes, ensuring that designs are well\-articulated, traceable, and implementation\-ready.
* Operate as part of the central architecture team, partnering with peer architects to align solutions, share direction, and promote consistency across the wider platform estate.
* Support and mentor emerging architects, helping to grow architectural capability and strengthen technical decision\-making across teams.
* Drive improvements that increase speed to market, operational efficiency, platform flexibility, and long\-term maintainability.


**About You**
* Proven experience architecting large\-scale, high\-performance distributed platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong ability to define solution direction across multiple teams and support engineering through design, build, and delivery.
* Ability to communicate architecture clearly to support alignment, decision\-making, and execution.
* Strong partnership skills, with the ability to work closely with product teams to shape solution roadmaps and align architecture with evolving business priorities.
* Confidence in leading decisions, managing trade\-offs, and influencing technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands\-on technical judgment, bringing clarity to ambiguity and helping teams move forward with confidence.


**Required Skills**
* Strong foundation in distributed systems, API and service design, modern backend architecture, and data\-intensive platform design.
* Experience with microservices architecture, domain\-driven design, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and modern delivery practices across private, public, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of web architecture, application development, integration patterns, and RESTful APIs.
* Experience with relational and operational data technologies, including Oracle and PostgreSQL, and data models that support high\-volume transaction processing.
* Ability to define non\-functional requirements across resilience, scalability, observability, security, and performance, and ensure these are reflected in solution design.
* Experience supporting modernization, migration, and platform transformation initiatives in environments where continuity of service is critical.


 Desirable Knowledge / Experience
   

  

* Experience in fraud, decisioning, workflow, or analyst\-facing platforms.
* Experience with high\-performance data storage technologies such as GemFire and similar in\-memory or distributed data platforms.
* Database experience, including Oracle and PostgreSQL, and data models that support high\-volume transaction processing and operational workflows.
* Experience with streaming or messaging platforms used to support event\-driven and near\-real\-time architectures.
* Experience integrating vendor and open\-source products into an overall platform architecture.
* Experience developing and supporting highly scalable, high\-performance transaction processing systems.
* Familiarity with architecture governance, risk, assurance, or enterprise review processes.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI or automation opportunities that improve user workflows, platform usability, or operational efficiency.


 This is an opportunity to shape the architecture of a critical platform, working with cross\-functional partners to evolve DPUI through customer, business, and platform priorities while helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality solutions for both current needs and future direction.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Defines and documents system architectures that are modular, maintainable, and extendible. Supports project teams in realizing designs and ensures alignment with stakeholder requirements.
   

  

 Key Areas of Responsibility
   

  

* System Development:
* Responsible for defining the system architecture within scope to a level that enables effective realization by project teams.
* Develops and documents architectures that decompose systems into modular, maintainable, and extendable subsystems and behaviors.
* Accountable for the technical integrity of all discipline designs within scope, including the detailed design work in related (sub)projects.
* Ensures that performance, scalability, and security requirements are appropriately addressed in the system design.
* Maintains consistency across system components and oversees their integration, including architectural aspects of verification and validation.
* Demonstrates deep understanding of system architecture, product development processes, and design methodologies such as modelling.

* Defines system architectures that meet stakeholder requirements across functions.
* Elicits system requirements within scope from all relevant stakeholders, including marketing.
* Supports marketing in customer interactions and go\-to\-market preparations.

* Acts as a regular point of contact for project stakeholders on architectural matters.
* Advises project management on make\-or\-buy decisions for system components.
* Demonstrates a clear understanding of project management processes and key milestones.
* Supports project management in identifying and managing technical risks, for example by initiating tests and prototypes. Ensures architectures developed in research are transferable and have a defined landing spot in development.

* Defines and monitors research and advanced development activities to ensure alignment with strategic goals.
* Actively maintains external relationships with R\&D institutes, universities, industry partnerships, and standardization bodies to foster collaboration and knowledge exchange.

* Years of experience: 12\+ years.

* RTOS or BareMetal (non\-RTOS) platform
* Knowledge of Microcontroller \+ Embedded peripherals (SPI, I2C, UART, Timers, DMA, ADC, GPIO, etc.)

-

title: Senior Staff Consulting Architect- Cloud Native
description:
Nutanix is seeking a Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – Cloud Native to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native platforms based on the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), across virtualized, bare\-metal, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 The role is intended for a highly experienced cloud\-native architect who can operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, lead complex and strategic platform transformation initiatives, and define scalable architecture standards across large and distributed environments.
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will combine deep hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native technologies with strong consulting, architecture governance, and technical leadership capabilities.
   

  

 The role will also be responsible for developing reference architectures, reusable delivery patterns, technical assets, and enablement programs, while mentoring Staff and Consulting Architects and raising the overall cloud\-native capability of the consulting organization.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is mandatory.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Strategic Advisory
* Provide end\-to\-end architecture leadership for complex enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native transformation programs.
* Define strategic platform architectures spanning:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare metal
+ Public cloud platforms including AWS and Azure
+ Hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
+ Edge and distributed infrastructure

* Lead architecture strategy for large\-scale and multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Translate business, application, infrastructure, security, and operational requirements into scalable and resilient cloud\-native architectures.
* Define target\-state architectures and multi\-phase transformation roadmaps covering platform adoption, application modernization, migration, automation, and operations.
* Advise customer executives, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders, platform engineering teams, and DevOps organizations on cloud\-native adoption strategies.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and technology selection criteria for enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for complex architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and escalations.
* Advanced Kubernetes \& Platform Architecture
* Architect enterprise NKP platforms at scale, including:
+ Multi\-cluster and fleet architectures
+ Multi\-tenancy and workload isolation
+ High availability and disaster recovery
+ Cluster lifecycle management
+ Platform scalability and capacity planning
+ Security and governance

* Define advanced Kubernetes networking, storage, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Design virtualization\-aware Kubernetes platforms considering:
+ Compute and resource allocation
+ NUMA and CPU topology
+ Storage performance
+ Network architecture
+ Failure domains
+ Cluster density
+ Performance optimization

* Define architecture patterns for GPU\-enabled and AI/ML workloads where applicable.
* Architect integration between Kubernetes and enterprise services including:
+ DNS
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ PKI and certificate management
+ Load balancers
+ Backup and disaster recovery
+ Enterprise monitoring and logging

* Establish architecture patterns for platform standardization across multiple business units, data centers, and geographies.
* Complex Transformation \& Delivery Leadership
* Provide technical leadership for high\-value and technically complex customer engagements from Day\-0 architecture through Day\-2 operations.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, design reviews, and transformation planning.
* Provide technical oversight for:
+ Platform deployment
+ Cluster onboarding
+ Application migration
+ Application modernization
+ Platform integration
+ Operational transformation

* Guide teams through complex implementation and troubleshooting scenarios spanning:
+ Kubernetes
+ Hypervisors
+ Networking
+ Storage
+ Security
+ Automation
+ CI/CD

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical architecture and delivery challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions are translated into practical, supportable, and repeatable implementation patterns.
* Review and provide technical governance for solution designs produced by Staff and Consulting Architects.
* Automation, GitOps \& Platform Engineering
* Define enterprise automation strategies for Kubernetes and infrastructure platforms.
* Establish standardized GitOps and CI/CD operating models using technologies such as:
+ GitHub Actions
+ GitLab CI
+ Jenkins
+ Argo CD
+ Tekton
+ Flux CD

* Design Infrastructure as Code frameworks using:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Define automation patterns integrating:
+ NKP APIs
+ Kubernetes APIs
+ Nutanix APIs
+ VMware APIs
+ AWS/Azure APIs

* Drive adoption of platform engineering principles, self\-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx) practices.
* Establish reusable automation frameworks and reference implementations that can be adopted across customer engagements.
* Promote secure, compliant, version\-controlled, and auditable platform delivery practices.
* Security, Governance, Resilience \& Operations
* Define enterprise security architecture across infrastructure, Kubernetes, and application platform layers.
* Establish security and governance models covering:
+ RBAC
+ Network policies
+ Pod Security Standards
+ Secrets and certificate management
+ Policy\-as\-Code
+ Workload isolation
+ Multi\-tenancy

* Design policy and governance frameworks using OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent technologies.
* Define enterprise approaches for:
+ Observability
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Backup and recovery
+ Disaster recovery
+ Business continuity

* Establish operational models covering platform lifecycle, upgrades, patching, capacity management, and resilience.
* Review platform performance, scalability, and operational maturity and drive continuous optimization.
* Technical Leadership, Mentoring \& Capability Development
* Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for the Cloud Native consulting organization.
* Mentor Staff Consulting Architects, Consulting Architects, and other technical consultants.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical coaching on complex customer engagements.
* Develop and deliver internal technical enablement programs covering Kubernetes, NKP, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native architecture.
* Define competency expectations and technical development paths for cloud\-native architects.
* Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leadership to establish targeted upskilling programs.
* Promote engineering and consulting best practices across geographies and delivery teams.
* Reference Architecture, Innovation \& Thought Leadership
* Create and maintain enterprise\-grade reference architectures, design patterns, deployment frameworks, and technical playbooks for cloud\-native platforms.
* Develop reusable consulting assets that improve delivery quality, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to Nutanix cloud\-native solutions.
* Drive innovation in areas such as:
+ Kubernetes platform engineering
+ Multi\-cluster management
+ GitOps
+ AI/ML platforms
+ GPU\-enabled Kubernetes
+ Application modernization
+ Hybrid/multi\-cloud
+ Developer platforms

* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and other technical teams to provide field feedback and influence product direction.
* Represent the consulting organization in technical forums, customer executive discussions, architecture communities, and industry events where appropriate.
* Contribute to whitepapers, technical blogs, solution briefs, and other thought\-leadership content.


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory Skills – Must Have
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience across infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, Kubernetes, platform engineering, or related technologies.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering large\-scale enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, operations, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare\-metal infrastructure

* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure architecture across:
+ Compute
+ Storage
+ Networking
+ Virtualization
+ Security

* Strong experience with Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes networking, storage, security, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Deep expertise in:
+ Load balancers
+ SSL/TLS and certificate management
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ DNS
+ Backup and DR
+ Enterprise observability

* Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD and GitOps platforms.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Strong understanding of Kubernetes APIs, infrastructure APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Proven experience designing multi\-cluster, highly available, resilient, and secure Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across Kubernetes, virtualization, networking, storage, automation, and application platform layers.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical engagements and architecture decisions.
* Excellent customer\-facing, consulting, presentation, and executive communication skills.


 Added Advantage – Good to Have
   

  

* Strong experience with public cloud Kubernetes services:
+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
+ Amazon EKS

* Experience with hybrid and multi\-cloud architecture.
* Experience with Kubernetes fleet/multi\-cluster management.
* Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platforms.
* Experience with service mesh technologies.
* Experience with GPU\-enabled Kubernetes and AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators and custom automation.
* Experience with application modernization and containerization.
* Experience with FinOps, capacity planning, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience influencing product strategy or working directly with product/engineering organizations.


 Trainable / Developable Skills
   

  

* Advanced NKP capabilities and emerging Nutanix cloud\-native technologies.
* Advanced AI/ML platform architecture and GPU orchestration.
* Emerging Kubernetes ecosystem technologies.
* Advanced platform engineering and developer experience frameworks.
* Advanced multi\-cloud governance and FinOps.
* New automation frameworks and cloud\-native tooling.


 Leadership \& Consulting Expectations
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect is expected to demonstrate the ability to:
   

  

* Operate effectively at C\-level, executive, enterprise architect, and senior technical stakeholder levels.
* Lead architecture decisions across multiple technology domains and organizational boundaries.
* Influence without direct authority.
* Challenge existing architecture assumptions and recommend pragmatic alternatives.
* Balance technical excellence with business outcomes, delivery timelines, operational complexity, and cost.
* Establish technical direction for complex and strategic customer programs.
* Independently handle ambiguous and high\-impact technical problems.
* Mentor other architects and elevate the technical maturity of the broader consulting organization.
* Convert field experience into reusable architecture patterns, methodologies, and intellectual property.


 Education \& Certifications
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is an advantage.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Nutanix certifications:
+ NCP
+ NKP
+ NCX

* VMware certifications:
+ VCP
+ VCAP/VCIX preferred

* Terraform Associate or equivalent
* Ansible Automation certification
* Relevant AWS/Azure certifications


 Location \& Work Shifts
   

  

* Pune – Work from Office
* Travel as required for customer assignments
* Willingness to work US and EMEA shifts based on customer and engagement requirements

title: Architect – AI-Powered Performance Verification Automation
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.
   

  

 NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub\-systems, Next\-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self\-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML\-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
* Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root\-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
* Integrate LLM\-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural\-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
* Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI\-driven solutions against real\-world workflows
* Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)
* Stay current with state\-of\-the\-art techniques in generative AI, reinforcement learning, and formal methods as they apply to hardware verification


**What We Need To See**
* B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development
* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with C/C\+\+, SystemVerilog/UVM is a plus
* Hands\-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
* Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
* Published work or patents in AI\-for\-verification or related domains

title: Principal, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal, Software Engineering
   

  

**Overview**
 In the time between when you swipe your Mastercard and you receive the approval, Authorization Decisioning has provided your transaction with more than 20 different market\-facing services—including industry leading fraud detection. Everyday Authorization Decisioning provides these same robust computational intelligence services to more than a billion transactions around the planet.
   

  

 As a Principal Software Engineer for Authorization Decisioning, you are a technical authority. You are responsible for providing a broad spectrum of technical leadership and decision making across our program and its partners in technology and product. You are a way finder. You are working across organizational lines to partner with architects, product managers, analysts, managers, and engineers to collaboratively and creatively find solutions to evolving our growing platform. You are an enabler. You are hands\-on experimenting, building, creating, guiding, and mentoring engineering teams through to seeing the realization of these solutions into production.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Between 20\-40% individual contributor with technical team leadership. Who is recognized as a team/s technical expert within a discipline and drives innovation and organizational growth through their contributions.
* Work on complex enterprise\-wide initiatives spanning multiple services/programs and drives resolution by collaborating with business/product owners, engineers, and architects to design and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles
* Has skills to succinctly articulate architecture patterns of complex systems, with business and technical implications, to executive and customer stakeholders
* Responsible for the analysis, design, development and delivery of software solutions
* Defines requirements for new applications and customizations, adhering to standards, processes and best practices.
* Set priorities, objectives, and drive deliverables within global technology domains and sub\-domains and engage with the broader technical community to anticipate developments in innovation and evaluate new solutions for future business platform system requirements.
* Leverages input of partners and personal experience to make thoughtful decisions on technical direction and then has the ownership to see those decisions through
* Practice sustainable incident response and conduct blameless postmortems, taking a holistic approach to problem\-solving during production events.
* Explain technical issues and solution strategies to stakeholders, ensure timely accomplishment of technical designs and delivery milestones and liaise with stakeholders to understand business needs.


**All About You**
* You’ve made your career in designing and building high performance, high transaction volume, and globally scalable platforms.
* As an individual contributor you made your name by solving the hard problems that no one else could and as your career grew so did the complexity. You still love getting your hands dirty, but now look forward to working with your friends to solve the big stuff that no one person can solve on their own.
* Designing and crafting the best software this world has ever seen might be your favorite thing, but you know that’s not the alpha and omega of your problem set. You relish your time with the SRE, Performance Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to ensure the architectures are correct and tuned and that your teams’ code is optimized for each system.
* You know you are responsible for software that is critical financial infrastructure for multiple nation states, but you also know that you can’t be everyone all the time, so you’ve extended your ownership to ensure the SDLC and governance processes are both efficient and responsible.
* You are intelligent and industrious, but people don’t know that because you tell them. Its because they see it in the way you lead. From ideation where you make everyone’s ideas feel heard and respected all the way through to production crisis where you stick with the engineers to overcome oversights not found until the last minute. Your personal culture sets the team culture.


 Proficiencies
   

  

* Deep experience in financial services — particularly in payments industry and hands on experience designing for standard and regulatory compliance – PCI\-DSS, GDPR, etc.
* Data\-intensive designing and architecture patterns – APIs, event\-driven\-services, batch\-services, messaging systems, and big data.
* Data\-intensive programming – Java, REST API, Microservices, Kafka, Axon, MQ, and Spring.
* Cloud and DevOps Architecture – Kubernetes, Docker, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry
* Databases – Oracle, SQL server, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ElasticSearch
* Tools – Eclipse or IntelliJ, Sonar, GIT, Maven, SQL Developer, Jenkins, CI/CD, Gatling


 Education
   

  

* Required undergraduate degree in Computer Science or in a STEM\-intensive degree program with related experience in software engineering.
* Preferred graduate degree in Computer Science or Business with related experience in fintech and payments.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead - AI
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced AI Engineering Leader to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of next\-generation AI\-powered Metaverse products. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Transformers, and AI product development. The role requires strong technical leadership, product ownership, and the ability to build scalable AI solutions integrated with immersive Metaverse environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive the AI technology vision and roadmap for Metaverse products.
* Lead end\-to\-end AI product development from concept to deployment.
* Design and implement LLM\-powered applications, AI agents, copilots, and intelligent assistants.
* Build scalable RAG architectures integrating vector databases and enterprise knowledge repositories.
* Develop and optimize ML and Deep Learning models for real\-world business applications.
* Lead research and implementation of Transformer\-based architectures.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, UX, BIM, CAD/CAE, Digital Twin, and Metaverse teams.
* Establish AI governance, model evaluation, security, and responsible AI practices.
* Drive cloud\-native AI deployments and MLOps practices.
* Mentor and lead high\-performing AI engineering and data science teams.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* 6\+ years of software engineering and product development experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Machine Learning and AI product development.
* Prompt Engineering: Utilizing LLMs and generative AI tools to accelerate code writing and data extraction.
* Data Governance: Ensuring AI models follow privacy laws, security protocols, and ethical data guidelines.
* Strong expertise in Generative AI and Large Language Models (OpenAI, Llama, Claude, Gemini, etc.).
* Proven experience designing and implementing RAG\-based systems.
* Deep understanding of Transformer architectures and attention mechanisms.
* Strong experience with Deep Learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.
* Experience in NLP, semantic search, embedding, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval.
* Expertise in AI model training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and optimization.
* Strong programming skills in Python and related AI ecosystems.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience implementing MLOps, CI/CD, model monitoring, and AI deployment pipelines.
* Strong product ownership and stakeholder management experience.
* Experience leading large engineering teams and delivering enterprise\-scale products.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience in Metaverse, Digital Twin, XR/VR/AR platforms.
* Exposure to CAD, CAE, BIM, construction technology, or industrial engineering domains.
* Experience building AI agents and autonomous workflows.
* Knowledge of Graph RAG, Knowledge Graphs, and Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with multi modal AI models (text, image, video, 3D).
* Exposure to computer vision, 3D scene understanding, and spatial computing.
* Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, or real\-time 3D platforms.
* Understanding of distributed systems and high\-performance computing.
* Publications, patents, or contributions in AI research.


**Educational Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Ability to define AI strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI technologies.
* Build and mentor world\-class AI engineering teams.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership, clients, and technical teams.


 Success Metrics
   

  

* Successful delivery of AI\-powered Metaverse products.
* Scalable deployment of LLM and RAG\-based solutions.
* AI innovation, patents, research contributions, and product impact.
* Team growth, engineering excellence, and customer satisfaction.

title: Specialist - Integration (AEM-IS)
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a seasoned SAP Integration Specialist with deep expertise in SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and Advanced Event Mesh. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable integration solutions that bridge cloud and on\-premise applications across global enterprise environments. You will also be instrumental in mentoring junior developers and driving best practices for integration design, security, and performance.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and lead the design of scalable, secure, and high\-performance integration solutions using SAP BTP Integration Suite, CPI, and Solace PubSub\+.
* Define integration strategies and roadmaps aligned with enterprise architecture and digital transformation goals.
* Lead the migration of legacy interfaces from SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance.
* Govern and optimize the use of SAP BTP services including API Management, Event Mesh, Open Connectors, and CPI\-DS.
* Oversee the configuration and administration of Solace messaging infrastructure, including advanced topic routing and durable subscriptions.
* Champion API\-first design principles, ensuring robust, reusable, and secure APIs using REST/SOAP standards.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to define integration requirements and governance models.
* Mentor and guide junior developers, conduct code reviews, and lead knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Establish best practices for monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting using tools like SAP Solution Manager, ElasticSearch, and Splunk.
* Drive continuous improvement through Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and innovation initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience Integration with 6\+ years in SAP integration, including SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, and SAP BTP.
* Proven experience in leading large\-scale integration projects across cloud and on\-premise systems.
* Deep technical expertise in ABAP, IDOCs, BAPI, RFC, and ALE.
* Strong command of Solace CLI, Solace APIs, and Solace Cloud Console.
* AI\-augmented development experience
* Proficiency in Java, Groovy, Python, and integration\-specific scripting.
* In\-depth understanding of security protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL) and API lifecycle management.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and hybrid integration scenarios.
* Exposure to AI tools/technology would be nice to have.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAP certifications in Integration Suite, BTP, or Cloud Platform Integration.
* Good understanding of API Management tools like IBM API Connect, Apigee etc.
* Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with event\-driven architectures, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Exposure to SAP Open Connectors, Graph API, and CAPM.
* Strong background in Agile delivery and tools like JIRA and Confluence.


**Technical Skills**
* Integration Tools: SAP CPI, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, API Management, Event Mesh, Cloud Connector
* Languages: Java, ABAP, Groovy, Python, JavaScript, XML/XSLT
* Protocols: REST, SOAP, IDOC, OData, RFC, BAPI, SFTP, HTTP
* Platforms: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, HANA
* Tools: Eclipse, NetWeaver Studio, Postman, SoapUI, GitHub
* Cloud \& DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, CI/CD


**Soft Skills**
* Strategic mindset with strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical thinker with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, global, and collaborative environment.


**About Medline India**
 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance \& and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.
   

  

 We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered \& engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
   

  

**About Medline Industries, LP**
 Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
   

  

 At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the \#1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

 We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise\-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban).

title: AI Automation Architect
description:
**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking a seasoned QE Strategist and AI Automation Architect to join our Quality Engineering \& Automation practice. This is a highly visible, client\-facing leadership role that sits at the intersection of AI innovation, enterprise test strategy, and delivery excellence. The ideal candidate brings deep insurance industry expertise, a strong hands\-on technical foundation in AI\-driven test automation, performance testing, and a proven track record of leading geographically distributed QE teams.
 



  





**Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Leadership \& QE Governance** 



* Define and own the enterprise\-wide testing strategy, including standards, methodologies, governance models, and quality frameworks.
* Conduct current\-state assessments of client systems, processes, and tooling; provide actionable, data\-driven quality recommendations.
* Lead the design and implementation of Agentic AI testing frameworks and drive the organization's overall AI QE strategy.
* Serve as a thought leader on AI\-infused quality engineering, continuously evaluating emerging tools and incorporating them into the automation roadmap.



  





**Client Engagement \& Business Development** 



* Contribute substantively to RFPs, proposal development, and client presentations; effectively articulate complex technical concepts to C\-suite executives and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Build and sustain trusted advisor relationships with client leadership, proactively identifying opportunities to expand QE value delivery.
* Represent the QE practice in steering committees, executive reviews, and cross\-functional planning sessions.
* Contribute to creation of GTM assets \& reusable accelerators creation, write thought leadership articles/blogs/webinars, speak in conferences or panels.



  





**Delivery \& Program Management** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery accountability for client engagements managing multiple mid\-to\-large teams across geographies and time zones.
* Develop project plans, resource models, risk registers, and status reporting for concurrent QE workstreams.
* Partner with development, DevOps, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration of AI test automation into CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery cycles.



  





**Architecture \& Hands\-On Engineering** 



* Design and architect robust, scalable, and maintainable test automation frameworks covering functional, regression, performance, and integration testing.
* Be hands\-on in building frameworks and scripts centered on AI, automation \& performance, including the creation of AI agents from scratch.
* Create POCs around AI \& automation and conduct technical demos for clients.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, best practices, and code review processes for automated and performance test scripts.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate best\-fit automation tools and technologies aligned to project and organizational needs.
* Develop automated monitoring and reporting mechanisms to track test execution, defect trends, and quality metrics; provide stakeholders with regular health reports.



  





**People Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Mentor and develop QE engineers and leads, elevating technical skills and deepening understanding of AI\-infused automation and performance testing.
* Foster a continuous\-improvement culture through knowledge sharing, structured training programs, and adoption of industry best practices.
* Provide technical leadership and subject\-matter expertise across test automation teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field (advanced degree preferred).
* 15\-20 years of experience in software testing, with 6\+ years leading technical QA/automation teams.
* Demonstrated experience delivering QE programs within the insurance industry (P\&C, Life, Annuities, or Health preferred).
* Certifications in software testing or quality management (e.g., ISTQB Advanced, CSM) and project management (PMP) are a strong plus.

title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years exp, SP routing platforms, architectural and validation expertise
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose \#1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre\-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission\-critical networks prior to Go\-Live. We help Tier\-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network\-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top\-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next\-generation Service Provider Networks
   

  

* Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C\-level and senior engineering leadership.
* Solution Validation \& Assurance: Lead end\-to\-end testing of next\-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS\-XR 64\-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness.
* Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full\-scale, high\-fidelity customer simulations in world\-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi\-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment.
* Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity.
* Defect Advocacy \& Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution.
* Pre\-Sales \& Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre\-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR).
* Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence.


**Decision Making \& Scope of Impact**
* Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements.
* Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go\-Live success, network availability, multi\-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier\-1 accounts.
* Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards.


**Role\-Specific Responsibilities**
* Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies.
* Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR).
* Performance \& Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry\-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line\-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence.
* Automation \& Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines.
* Advanced Troubleshooting \& RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions.
* Knowledge Transfer \& Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best\-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education \& Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10–15\+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery.
* Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands\-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems.
* Consulting \& Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer\-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior\-level decision makers.
* Certifications: Expert\-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing \& Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired.
* Software \& Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML).
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high\-pressure environments.


**Preferred Technical Qualifications**
 Strong architectural understanding and hands\-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas:
   

  

* Service Provider Core \& Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport \& RON):
* Cisco SP Platforms
* Operating Systems
* Core Routing Protocols
* Segment Routing \& Traffic Engineering
* Multi\-Service VPNs \& EVPN
* SP Network Timing \& 5G Sync
* Routed Optical Networking (RON)
* SP Resiliency \& Security
* SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability \& Tooling:
* Cisco pyATS \& Genie Test Frameworks
* SP SDN Orchestration \& Controllers
* Data Modeling \& Interfaces
* Streaming Telemetry \& Observability
* Scripting \& CI/CD Pipelines
* Test Lab Simulation, Traffic Generation \& Telco Cloud:
* Hardware Traffic Generation
* Virtualization \& Digital Twin Platforms
* SP Cloud \& Telco Infrastructure


**Leadership \& Autonomy**
* Self\-Direction \& Initiative: Operates with high autonomy, determining methods and validation frameworks on strategic, high\-visibility customer projects.
* Strategic Advisor: Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leadership and customers, translating strategic technology goals into actionable validation programs.
* Team Leadership: Champions innovation, leading internal initiatives to advance SVS testing capabilities, tooling, and delivery best practices.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

 **Data Architect** 
 Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards.  You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right.  Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, reference architectures and platform services for production solutions.

 Deep knowledge of scalable data architecture, AI feature/data pipelines, model integration patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization, observability and resilience Technical Architecting.

title: Solution Architect, Process Intelligence
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long\-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
   

  

 The Solution Architect, Process Intelligence is the senior technical owner of Edwards Lifesciences’ enterprise Process Intelligence capability on the Celonis platform. This role has end‑to‑end technical accountability across both Celonis platform pillars: Process Mining (data integration, object‑centric data models, analytical assets, and execution solutions) and Celonis Process Management (Process Designer, Navigator, and the governed process repository). The architect defines the event log architecture, ERP data extraction strategy, pipeline reliability, platform administration, and the technical standards that enable scalable, accurate, and audit‑ready process insights. While Order‑to‑Cash (O2C) is the initial scope, the architecture is designed to extend across additional enterprise process domains including Procure‑to‑Pay, manufacturing operations, and Idea‑to‑Market. This role acts as the primary knowledge transfer recipient from the Celonis SI engagement (896 hours, ending September 2026\) and serves as the India‑side technical leader for the BPM execution team. Upon SI handover, this role leads the maintenance, evolution, and scaling of the Celonis platform independently.
   

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**
* Define and maintain the enterprise event log architecture, object‑centric data models (OCDM), Perspectives, and Knowledge Model that enable process mining, conformance analysis, variant detection, and KPI measurement across enterprise processes. Own the technical design decisions that determine how business objects, events, and relationships are modeled within the platform (25%).
* Own the end‑to‑end data integration strategy from source ERP systems (Oracle JDE) into the Celonis platform, including connector configuration, extraction method selection (JDBC, REST, batch vs. real‑time), transformation scripts (PQL), data integration scheduling, and pipeline orchestration. Ensure stable, performant, and governed data flows that meet SLA requirements (20%).
* Serve as the technical owner of the Celonis Process Management (CPM) environment, including Process Designer, Navigator, and the enterprise process repository. Manage platform administration including SSO configuration, user roles and permissions, Home Site configuration, and release cycle governance. Ensure the CPM environment is operationally ready for enterprise‑scale BPMN modeling and process catalog consumption (15%).
* Serve as the primary technical counterpart to the Celonis SI team during the implementation engagement (May–September 2026\). Lead knowledge transfer activities across all SOW phases (Connect, Data Ready, Analyze, Execute, Handover) and ensure internal capability is built to sustain, operate, and evolve the platform independently post‑engagement. Shadow SI consultants during OCDM configuration, Studio asset development, and Action Flow design (15%).
* Establish and govern the data quality framework — including validation rules, reconciliation procedures, data scorecards, and root‑cause resolution workflows — to ensure mining outputs are accurate, consistent, and audit‑ready. Define acceptance criteria for event logs and analytical assets before publication to business stakeholders (10%).
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Process Intelligence Data Engineer (P3\), Senior Analyst, Process Excellence (P3\), and broader Pune BPM execution team. Define technical standards, conduct architecture reviews, establish reusable templates and patterns, and ensure alignment with Edwards enterprise IT governance and security requirements (10%).
* Evaluate and recommend adoption paths for emerging Celonis capabilities (e.g., Process Sphere, Action Flows, AgentC, AI‑driven insights) aligned to Edwards’ process intelligence roadmap. Configure and validate execution solutions including Action Flows and Business Apps for prioritized value opportunities (5%).


**What you’ll need (Required):**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, solution architecture, or analytics platform architecture roles.
* Hands‑on experience with the Celonis platform, including data integration, PQL (Process Query Language), object‑centric data modeling, and Studio asset development.
* Strong expertise in SQL, relational database design, and ERP data schemas (Oracle JDE, SAP, or equivalent).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT data pipelines at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define data governance frameworks, quality standards, and architectural documentation.
* Experience with platform administration including SSO, user provisioning, and role‑based access control.
* Ability to lead technical delivery in a global, matrixed organization and serve as a technical mentor for colleagues with less experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
* High level of independence, sound judgment, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, greenfield environments.


**What else we look for (Preferred):**
* Celonis certification(s) such as Celonis Data Engineer, Celonis Analyst, or Celonis Solution Architect.
* Experience with Celonis Process Management (CPM/Symbio), including Process Designer and Navigator.
* Experience implementing Celonis from greenfield (not just operating an existing deployment).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS) and modern data stack tooling.
* Python or other scripting language proficiency for data automation, validation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Experience operating in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals) requiring data integrity, audit readiness, and SOX compliance.
* Familiarity with BPMN 2\.0 process modeling standards and process excellence methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Experience with Action Flows, Business Apps, or similar execution/automation solutions within process mining platforms.

title: Architect - OT Security (Network Security)
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced OT Security Architect with strong expertise in Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and Network Security to lead the design and implementation of secure, resilient, and compliant IT/OT/Cloud security architectures. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in protecting business\-critical operational environments by implementing Zero Trust principles, securing industrial networks, and ensuring compliance with industry standards such as IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, and ISO 27017\. This role requires deep technical expertise, architecture leadership, stakeholder engagement, and hands\-on experience in securing complex OT environments across energy, utilities, industrial automation, and cloud\-connected operational platforms.
 



  




* **Role: Architect \- OT Security (Network Security)**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Design and govern secure IT, OT, and cloud\-connected network architectures aligned with industry security standards and operational requirements.
* Develop and implement defense\-in\-depth security strategies for OT and ICS environments.
* Define network segmentation, VLANs, DMZ architectures, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure remote access controls.
* Lead Zero Trust security initiatives including ZTNA, MFA, PAM, and identity\-based access control implementation.
* Architect secure data flows between industrial systems, enterprise networks, cloud platforms, and remote operational environments.
* Design and implement secure cloud\-connected OT architectures leveraging AWS security services and controls.
* Establish architecture guardrails, security standards, hardening baselines, and implementation best practices.
* Conduct threat modeling, security assessments, risk reviews, and vulnerability management activities.
* Support compliance assessments against IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, ISO 27017, CRA, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Design and review industrial firewall, gateway, IDS/IPS, and network security solutions.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for network security, segmentation, VPN, firewall, DNS, routing, and access\-related issues.
* Secure and assess industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, and MQTT.
* Drive SIEM integration, monitoring, alert investigation, incident response, and security operations readiness.
* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, operations, cybersecurity, and business stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architecture governance, and customer\-facing security consulting.
* Present security risks, mitigation plans, and architectural recommendations to leadership and clients.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 10 to 15 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Network Security, OT Security, or Security Architecture roles.
* Strong expertise in OT/ICS security architecture and industrial network security design.
* Extensive experience implementing IEC 62443 security frameworks and defense\-in\-depth architectures.
* Deep understanding of Purdue Model architecture and OT zone/conduit segmentation principles.
* Hands\-on experience with network technologies including VLANs, routing, switching, segmentation, VPNs, and DMZ architectures.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture, ZTNA, MFA, PAM, identity governance, and access security controls.
* Experience with industrial firewall and gateway solutions including Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, and Siemens Scalance.
* Expertise in IDS/IPS, SIEM integration, network monitoring, asset inventory, vulnerability management, and security operations.
* Strong knowledge of AWS security services including VPC, Security Groups, NACLs, WAF, private connectivity, logging, and monitoring.
* Experience designing and securing cloud\-connected OT and Industrial IoT environments.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, and MQTT.
* Experience conducting security assessments, risk analysis, compliance reviews, and remediation planning.
* Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities across OT, IT, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Experience supporting critical infrastructure, energy, utilities, renewable energy, SCADA, and industrial automation environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, consulting, and leadership skills.
* Ability to lead architecture reviews, security governance initiatives, and strategic transformation programs.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
