title: Associate Director_3367
description:
**About The Job**
 The AI Factory is a central delivery unit at Allianz Technology that builds and deploys AI\-powered solutions across the Allianz Group. It runs four pillars, Personal Productivity, AI\-Native Ways of Working, Application Rebuild \& Modernization, and AI Use Case Delivery, on top of a shared AI platform ecosystem that provides the runtime, governance, observability, and reusable building blocks every solution runs on.
   

  

 The AI Factory Lead India will head the AI Factory's India team members in India: AI Engagement Managers who shape and steer OE engagements, Forward Deployed Engineers who build and ship the underlying solutions, and AI Platform Engineers who build and operate the shared AI platform every solution runs on. Together they turn OE and Group pain points into deliverable, funded AI projects through a defined lifecycle from Idea to Handover, backed by a growing library of reusable AI building blocks that turn one OE's solution into the next OE's head start. The AI Factory Lead India will also bridge the end\-to\-end delivery, setting priorities across concurrent engagements, growing and coaching AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers, and acting as the senior escalation point with AI Factory, Allianz Technology leadership, Heads of ITs', and Account Managers. The role balances demand shaping and delivery execution with platform health, and represents the India team within Allianz Technology's global AI Factory leadership.
   

  

**What You Do**
* Lead and grow the India AI Factory team \- AI Engagement Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and AI Platform Engineers and other AI roles \- setting priorities across concurrent OE engagements.
* Coach and develop team members; manage workload distribution, performance, hiring, and career growth across all three disciplines.
* Own the Factory's India delivery portfolio: sequence engagements, resolve cross\-team resource conflicts, and ensure reusable patterns (MVS, AI Building Blocks, platform capabilities) flow between projects.
* Act as the senior escalation point and relationship owner with OE leadership, Heads of IT, and Account Managers, unblocking engagements Engagement Managers cannot resolve alone.
* Own the India team's overall demand pipeline; prioritize opportunities, allocate Engagement Managers, and balance qualification, delivery, and run\-support work across concurrent engagements.
* Represent the AI Factory in governance forums, portfolio reviews, and budget and resourcing conversations with senior stakeholders, up to CTO and Board level where required.
* Ensure the AI Platform Engineers' roadmap (runtime, governance, FinOps, observability) reflects needs surfaced by live engagements.
* Champion reuse: ensure Forward Deployed Engineers contribute new patterns back to the central building\-block catalogue and Engagement Managers factor reuse into scoping.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover model \- including support models, SLAs/OLAs, runbooks, and MLOps/monitoring \- and maintain oversight of security, compliance, and responsible\-AI standards across all Factory deliverables.
* Track Factory\-wide KPIs (time\-to\-value, reuse rate, delivery predictability, platform cost and reliability) and drive continuous improvement.


**What You Bring**
* Proven experience leading multi\-disciplinary technical teams (delivery/engagement, engineering, and platform functions) in large, matrix organizations, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* People management track record: hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development across senior technical and delivery roles.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to challenge scope and platform decisions honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience running a delivery portfolio: demand shaping, prioritization, resourcing, budget ownership, and risk management across concurrent engagements.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


 Not Expected To Hands\-on Build Or Hold Formal Certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) \- Working Knowledge Of The Following Is Needed To Guide Trade\-offs, Hold Credible Technical Conversations With The Team, And Challenge Or Support Architectural And Platform Decisions
   

  

* Enterprise and solution architecture concepts \- technical blueprints, reusable solution frameworks, AI reference architectures, and integration standards.
* GenAI\-enabled capabilities such as intelligent assistants, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agents, and automation pipelines.
* Architecture patterns for multi\-system integration, API orchestration, and data harmonization.
* Cloud\-native platforms and services on at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* The modern AI/data stack \- vector databases, embedding stores, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM/agent framework integration.
* AI governance and responsible\-AI principles, including model governance, data lineage, and auditability.
* Solution lifecycle management and reuse practices (MVS, AI Building Blocks) across sandbox, standardization, and retirement stages.


**What We Offer**

* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co\-create the best customer experience.
   

  

 We service the entire spectrum of digitalization, from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. * Excellence in communication with technical and non\-technical peers

* 5\+ years of experience in SQL and NoSQL technologies, data modeling, query optimization, caching strategies, and transactional vs eventual consistency trade\-offs.
* Familiarity with Micro\-Frontends and front\-end platform governance is a plus.

**Eligibility Criteria**

Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.

 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.

 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.

Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment

 Release Management

* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process

* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.

Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.

title: Principal Engineer, Real-time Payments (Technology & Architecture)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer, Real\-time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

 Principal Engineer, Real time Payments (Technology \& Architecture)
   

  

**Overview**
 The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide.
   

  

 RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard’s enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
   

  

 Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time—through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and architecture \& technology leadership for multiple Real\-time Payments products and platform capabilities across multiple markets.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who:
   

  

* Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems
* Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas
* Is deeply hands‑on and leads by technical design \& architecture excellence
* Contributes \& drives architecture and product design aspects
* Owns key technology \& implementation decisions including all non\-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability


 The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‑to‑end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes.
   

  

* Design \& Technical Execution
* Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets.
* Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e.g., microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design).
* Design, build, and maintain high‑quality software components and services for RTP products.
* Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles.
* Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability.
* Own end‑to‑end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production.
* Translate functional and non‑functional requirements into robust technical implementations.
* Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices.
* Hands‑on Engineering \& Code Quality
* Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations.
* Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design.
* Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality.
* Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems.
* Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers.
* Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)
* Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
* Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs.
* Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design.
* Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks.
* Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities.
* Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise.
* Cross Market Consistency \& Platform Evolution
* Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions.
* Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services.
* Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction.
* Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums.
* Engineering Leadership \& Bar Raising
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making.
* Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence.
* Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent.
* Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.


**All About You**
 Experience \& Technical Expertise
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale.
* Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms.
* Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures.
* Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling.
* Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.


 Technology Breadth
   

  

* Strong background in enterprise backend development with hands\-on experience across object\-oriented \& functional programming languages \- Java/Spring, React, Angular, Erlang
* Experience working across multiple technology stacks and system layers (application, messaging, data, platform).
* Familiarity with cloud and containerized environments; ability to operate effectively across heterogeneous market deployments.
* Payments or financial services experience (e.g., real time processing, regulated environments) is a strong plus.


 Leadership \& Ways of Working
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through technical credibility.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making high impact technical decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* A mindset focused on long term platform health, not just short term delivery.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.

**Working Expectations**

* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.

title: Sr Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Internationalization Software Engineer**
**About The Job**
 The Globalization Experience Team is searching for an Internationalization Software Engineer responsible for creating, enhancing, and maintaining robust software and tooling so SAS products work correctly for global users across languages, locales, and character sets. This role focuses on building and integrating foundational internationalization capabilities—Unicode correctness, locale‑sensitive formatting and sorting, and string externalization/resource management—while partnering with product teams to embed best practices early in the software development cycle. You’ll also use AI\-assisted techniques (when appropriate) to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation, helping teams deliver global\-ready software efficiently and consistently.
   

  

**As An Internationalization AI Software Developer, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain software, libraries, and tooling that enable product teams to efficiently build high‑quality, global‑ready software in compliance with SAS Internationalization guidelines and standards.
* Work effectively in mature and legacy code to resolve customer\-impacting defects, coordinating with support and product teams to deliver patch updates for high\-priority fixes with strong testing and regression awareness to protect production behavior
* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders—including product development teams, product managers, project managers, support engineers, and testers—to integrate internationalization best practices early and throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with internationalization testers to guide testing strategies, investigate defects, and drive engineering improvements that result in high‑quality, globally usable product deliverables.
* Use AI\-assisted tools responsibly as part of day‑to‑day engineering (e.g., accelerating code review and refactoring suggestions, log/defect triage, test generation, and documentation) while ensuring correctness, traceability, and alignment with SAS development standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a software developer, with hands‑on experience applying internationalization best practices and working with industry‑standard libraries such as ICU and CLDR.
* Experience using modern developer productivity tools (including AI\-assisted coding and review tools) to improve delivery speed and quality, with an understanding of validation practices (tests, reviews, and responsible use).
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Python, and C, with the ability to read, understand, and contribute to production codebases.
* Working proficiency in shell scripting (e.g., Bash or similar) to support automation, tooling, or development workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional teams including developers, testers, and product stakeholders.
* Hands‑on experience using GitHub in a team environment, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence as part of an Agile development process, including issue tracking, planning, and documentation.
* Ability to adjust working hours to accommodate a variety of time zones
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.


**Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience with SAS programming or familiarity with SAS language, tools, or development environments.
* Experience with TypeScript and Java Script a plus.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, or deployment automation.
* Proficiency in additional spoken language.

**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade\-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience


**Work Timings:** 
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
 We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Brief Description**
 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Full\-Stack Technical Owner** 
 to take end\-to\-end technical ownership of a business\-critical application, currently
 **Tempo – ESP Global Services' Workforce Management System** 
 .
   

  

 The role covers
 **design, development, security, integrations, deployment, production support and continuous enhancement** 
 across backend, web, mobile and database layers. This is an individual\-contributor role requiring strong hands\-on coding and technical ownership rather than people management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the application architecture, design, development and technical roadmap.
* Develop and maintain .NET/C\# backend APIs, React web applications and mobile applications.
* Design and maintain databases, APIs and integrations with enterprise systems.
* Own application security, authentication, SSO, RBAC and vulnerability remediation.
* Manage cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and production releases.
* Personally troubleshoot and resolve production incidents across the technology stack.
* Manage mobile releases for Android/iOS and ensure application performance and reliability.
* Work with business, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to deliver technical solutions.
* Maintain architecture, API, data\-flow and operational documentation.
* Take ownership of other applications/platforms assigned by ESP in the future.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience with strong hands\-on delivery.
* Strong C\#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, Entity Framework and SQL Server experience.
* Strong React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS skills.
* Hands\-on Android/iOS or React Native development experience.
* Experience with Azure, CI/CD, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps and application monitoring.
* Knowledge of OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, RBAC and secure coding practices.
* Experience with mobile location services, geofencing and offline/sync capabilities is desirable.
* Strong production support, troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams is an advantage.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrable experience owning and supporting a live production application end\-to\-end.
* Strong ability to work independently and take full technical accountability for an application.


**Ideal Candidate**
 A senior hands\-on engineer who can
 **design it, build it, secure it, deploy it, troubleshoot it and continuously improve it** 
 — across the full application lifecycle.

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Salesforce Professional Services \- Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi\-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth \& innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity \& impact.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise\-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Clouds, ensuring teams leverage developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and enforce platform security.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to establish evaluation frameworks that measure AI performance and business value.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 18\+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Salesforce Industries Cloud, Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, and Vlocity OmniStudio, as well as familiarity with Agentforce.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health \& Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.


**Preferred Requirements**
* CTA
* Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect).
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands\-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills \- nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills \- experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

 This role drives the architecture vision for data platforms, analytics products, and cloud\-based solutions while ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and performance.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise\-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud\-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities.**
 Cloud\-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads.
   

  

**Platform Hardening, Network \& Container Security**
* Implement and manage Kubernetes Network Policies for micro\-segmentation and least\-privilege communication.
* Configure and enforce OpenShift Security Context Constraints (SCCs) and Multi\-Category Security (MCS).
* Deploy and operate Container Security Operators for continuous vulnerability scanning of running pods and images.
* Build platform functionality for image scanning, signing, and policy enforcement Advanced Cluster Security for runtime threat detection, compliance monitoring, and network policy enforcement.
* Drive platform compliance with CIS benchmarks (Kubernetes and Linux), FIPS, and zero\-trust guidelines.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large\-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience: 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on building scalable distributed systems, cloud platforms, or security infrastructure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Cluster API (CAPI), NetworkPolicies, SCCs, MCS, and related security primitives.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability.
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), and kernel security modules.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:** 
 GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* **Delivery toolchain:** 
 GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* **Integrations:** 
 ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

title: Lead Engineer - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing \& fulfilment and post\-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
   

  

 As an OMS Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the team building and supporting omni\-channel commerce capabilities. You will own technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, resilient, and aligned with the broader commerce platform strategy. Working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Owners and Retail Tech Teams, you will deliver scalable, resilient, and secure omni\-channel commerce capabilities. You will champion engineering best practices, code quality, observability, and continuous improvement across the team.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Lead the design, development, and evolution of Order Management capabilities including order orchestration, inventory availability, fulfilment, returns, and post\-purchase experiences.
* Own the technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions for OMS platforms and related integrations.
* Design and build scalable, resilient, API\-first and event\-driven services supporting omnichannel commerce use cases such as Click \& Collect (BOPIS), Ship\-from\-Store, Endless Aisle, and Delivery Promise. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Retail Technology, Supply Chain, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive integration of OMS with Commerce Platforms, ERP, WMS, Payments, Logistics, and Customer Service systems.
* Ensure inventory visibility, order processing, fulfilment, and returns workflows are accurate, reliable, and scalable across channels and regions.
* Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, secure development practices, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and promote best practices in microservices, cloud\-native architecture, observability, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
* Mentor and coach engineers, providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and hands\-on support for complex initiatives.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve developer productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and building Order Management capabilities using Java/Spring Boot or equivalent frameworks, including implementation, extension, integration, and customization of packaged or custom order management solutions.
* 3\+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team.
* Experience with enterprise order management platforms such as Fluent Commerce (preferred), IBM Sterling OMS, Manhattan Associates, Kibo Commerce, or Salesforce OMS is highly desirable.
* Hands\-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures, building scalable, resilient, and production\-grade services.
* Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end order lifecycle, including order capture, sourcing, fulfilment, shipment, returns, exchanges, and post\-purchase processes.
* Proven experience customizing and extending OMS capabilities to support evolving business requirements, omnichannel fulfilment models, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong knowledge of omnichannel commerce operations, including Ship\-from\-Store (SFS), Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship\-to\-Store, Curbside Pickup, Endless Aisle, and associated order routing strategies.
* Solid understanding of inventory management, sourcing optimization, fulfilment orchestration, and order allocation concepts across stores, DCs, and third\-party fulfilment networks.
* Proven experience integrating OMS platforms with Commerce, WMS, ERP, POS, Payment, 3PL, Carrier, and Customer Service systems to enable end\-to\-end order visibility and orchestration.
* Experience designing OMS\-centric microservice architectures with clear domain boundaries across Order Management, Inventory, Sourcing, Fulfilment, Returns, and Customer Service capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience with Kafka or similar event\-streaming platforms for event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise\-scale system integrations.
* Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, and optimization of high\-throughput, business\-critical commerce platforms.
* Experience defining and implementing capacity planning, resiliency, and scaling strategies to support peak trading events and global commerce operations.
* Experience driving technical architecture, establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience leveraging AI\-assisted engineering tools, coding agents, and LLM\-powered development workflows to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define, build and implement a Generative AI Agent platform supporting priority banking services from discovery through production rollout.
* Architect enterprise\-grade platform capabilities, including agent orchestration (supervisors/super agents), workflow design, tool/function integration, memory and state management, skill registry/management, and reusable patterns that enable consistent delivery across teams.
* Drive platform adoption at scale by creating reference implementations, onboarding pathways, developer enablement (APIs/SDKs, templates, documentation), and governance that accelerates safe, repeatable delivery of agent solutions.
* Own platform performance management: define success metrics and SLOs, implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), run evaluations, and continuously tune reliability, accuracy, latency and cost to optimise outcomes.
* Oversee end\-to\-end delivery execution, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies and milestones; coordinate across teams to remove blockers and ensure timely, high\-quality outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, translating technical options into clear recommendations, trade\-offs (value/risk/cost), and delivery plans to support informed decision\-making.
* Stay current on GenAI/agent advancements (including LangChain/LangGraph and emerging alternatives), assess applicability to HSBC use cases, and drive pragmatic upgrades that keep the platform secure, compliant and competitive.


 To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements
   

  

* Education \& English: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science/Engineering (or related); strong communication skills including verbal communication in English.
* Software Engineering: 5\+ years’ handon coding practice, strong Python or Golang, with usage of at least one major cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP); ability to deploy and operate services in production (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
* GenAI / LLM Delivery: 2\+ years building and shipping LLM/GenAI applications; Proven practices with agentic workflows, multi\-agents, and tool/function calling, and RAG, search, and vector databases, design \& develop agent tooling and integration patterns (e.g., MCP and tool/function calling)
* Problem\-solving \& commitment, strong ability to develop creative solutions to complex challenges, working effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
